Mo'grosh Stronghold is a set of ogre-infested caves located in northeastern Loch Modan. The Mo'grosh ogres number several darkmaulers and earthbenders, and serve the Twilight's Hammer. They are in progress of defiling the land with the elementium spikes, just as their neighbors did at the camp on the drained Loch, and must be stopped. The ogres are led by the disciple of Cho'gall himself, Gor'kresh. Judging from the ruins in the area, it is likely that the stronghold was a troll settlement at one time, though whether the ogres drove the trolls out or the trolls had left long before, leaving the land open for the ogres to move in and build their ogre mound, is unknown.

The Mizjah Ruins are an area southeast of Grom'gol Base Camp inhabited by Mosh'Ogg Brutes and Mosh'Ogg Witch Doctors. These ogres are responsible for ambushing supply caravans going to Stonard. During the events of Rise of the Zandalari, the place was overrun by Jungle Serpents.

Mistvale Valley is a valley in the southern part of the Cape of Stranglethorn inhabited by the great Mistvale gorillas. Adventurers often come through here looking to find :Mistvale Giblets, Gorilla Fangs, or the very rare :Aged Gorilla Sinew.

Misty Valley is located in the northwestern corner of Swamp of Sorrows, north of the entrance to Deadwind Pass. It is home to the native Misty Grells and a giant panther, Duskfang, who lives in the far back of the valley in a cave. Prior to the Cataclysm, the area was filled with Tangled Horrors, Swampwalker Elders, and Swampwalkers. The Mire Lord inhabited the valley's cave. It is unknown where the elementals went, or whether the grells and panther lived there before but were inaccessible.

It is possible to view the Dawning Isles from the Misty Shore, with the eerie Fenris Keep in the distance. During the Fourth War, Horde forces created a distraction along the Misty Shore to lure the Bloodfang Pack out of their position on Fenris Isle.

Mob herbalism is the act of gathering herbs and other related items from the corpse of dead nature creatures, exclusively giants and elementals. To do so one must have the appropriate level of Herbalism and simply act as though they were gathering from any other herb node. Similar to skinning the player requires a herbalism skill of at least five times the target mob's level, but unlike skinning herbalists cannot skill up this way.

Mob mining or ore skinning is the act of gathering ore, raw gems, elemental ingredients, or vendorable items from the corpse of dead giants and elementals. To mine a dead mob, you must be at the appropriate level of mining. This is determined by multiplying the mob level by five. A level 70 mob requires a mining skill of 350 (70 x 5). A level 80 mob requires a skill of 450. Unfortunately, mining cannot be leveled in this fashion. Also, just as if you are mining a normal node, you must have a mining pick.

A model is a representation of an object in the game world. It is the spacial structure of the object within the game space environment. Depending on the game engine, the model may have other various properties at various nodes, indicating joints, flexibility, attachment points (for holding an object) and other physical properties. A WoW model is "3-D graphic object". Producing a workable 3-D graphics model is a fair piece of work, combining artistic skill with a good amount of coding and debugging. Molten Belt is a Leatherworking-crafted belt that is suitable for classes that wear both leather armor and mail armor. This is a nice belt for Rogues if they don't have a full set. Hunters also like this belt due to the high Agility.
Molten Fists are a pair of Level 51 quality Mail Gloves that improve Agility, Stamina and Critical Strike.

Mok'rash the Cleaver is a sea giant found on Janeiro's Point west of Booty Bay in the Cape of Stranglethorn. The giants of Stranglethorn Vale sank Captain Hecklebury Smotts' ships. Mok'rash has Smott's monogrammed sash.
Molthor is a Zandalari troll found in the Swollen Vault on the Isle of Thunder. He becomes accessible after access to Stormsea Landing is gained.

The Molsen Farm is one of the many farms of Westfall that have once been taken over by the Defias Brotherhood. Since the fall of the organization, only the deadly mechanical Harvest Watchers roam the fields. Private Molsen of the Westfall Brigade may have a family connection with the farm. During the Burning Legion's invasion, the area fell under the Burning Legion's control. Its residents were enslaved by nathrezim and were later killed by the defenders.

Two groups of fire elementals stand on this bridge - on the far side, the swirling portal to Molten Core. This is where the Attunement to the Core quest can be completed - the core fragment is on the far side of the bridge, next to the portal. Note that you do not need to enter the core to finish this quest; in fact, if you enter the core by mistake, when you exit the core you will appear outside of the depths, next to the questgiver for the attunement quest. It is in this foundry that the Dark Irons forge their golems. This area is small, filled with small groups of elite golems and non-elite dark iron dwarves. The rare spawn Panzor the Invincible will spawn here occasionally.
Molasses Firewater is sold by Stomper Kreeg in Dire Maul North. Stomper Kreeg acts as a vendor only for characters who have been declared King by killing King Gordok.
